transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I'm... well, I guess I'm here because work is getting messed up. I'm an electrician, and lately, I just... I can't seem to focus on one estimate or code form. It's like, I'll be looking at it, and then a drill goes off, or my phone buzzes, or I just get this idea about how to reorganize the workshop, and... I just drop what I'm doing. Things are starting to get mixed up on the jobs.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?
No. Not really. I feel fine, mostly. Just... distracted, like I said. I don't feel hopeless or anything.
Do you often feel restless, as if you need to be moving or doing something, even when you're trying to sit still or focus on a task?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... I don't really sit still much. I've been going pretty nonstop lately. 

Just going from job sites to bids... then I'll be in the workshop rewiring test panels. I keep starting these new home-automation ideas before the last one is even done. It's just... sitting around feels like wasting time. So I keep moving.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through, like interrupting others when they're talking or making sudden decisions without considering the consequences?
I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really noticed doing anything like that. I just do my work. I don't think I'm making sudden decisions or... interrupting people. Just normal, I guess.
Do you find that you often fail to give close attention to details or make careless mistakes in your work as an electrician?
No, not really. I mean, I know what I'm doing. I've been an electrician for a while, so... I don't really make careless mistakes. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing major.
Do you often have trouble organizing your work or keeping track of what you're supposed to be doing, like losing your tools, forgetting steps in a process, or mixing up job details?
No. I mean... I know where my tools are. You kind of have to stay organized doing what I do, or someone gets hurt. So... no. I don't really mix up details or anything. I just do the work.
Do you find that you often lose things like your tools, keys, or paperwork, even if you know you should keep them organized?
I mean... I think I just said, I know where my tools are. I don't really lose my keys or anything either. I just keep my stuff where it belongs, so... no.
Do you often feel driven to keep going, like you can't slow down or relax even if you want to?

I guess... I just stay busy. I've been going pretty much nonstop lately. Just, you know, job sites, putting together bids, rewiring some test panels in the workshop. I've been starting a few new home-automation ideas before the last one is even done. I just... sitting still feels like wasting time. So I just keep working.
Do you often find yourself talking more than usual, or do you feel like you can't stay seated even when you're supposed to, like during meetings or downtime at work?
Not really. I'm not much of a talker to begin with, so... no. And I don't really have meetings. If I'm on a break or eating lunch, I sit down. It's... I don't know, it's just normal, I guess.

Do you often find it hard to wait for your turn, like in lines or when waiting for parts or equipment, or do you feel like you need to keep doing something all the time, even when you're supposed to wait?
I don't know. I mean... I wait in line if I have to. Like at the supply house, you just wait. It's not a big deal. I don't really get what you mean. I just wait my turn.
Do you often find yourself starting projects or tasks that are overly ambitious, risky, or not really necessary, even if they distract you from what you should be doing?

No, I wouldn't say that. I just... I do my work. The stuff I'm doing in the shop, it's just normal projects. It's not risky or anything. I don't really mess around with that kind of stuff, especially with electrical... you just do it the right way. So, no.
Do you often have trouble staying focused when you need to work on something that requires a lot of thinking, like planning a job or studying electrical codes, even if it's important?
Not really. I mean, if I have to look up a code or plan out a run, I just do it. It's my job. I don't really have trouble focusing on it. I just get it done.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, like feeling rested after only a few hours or not really feeling tired even when others would be?

Yeah, I guess. I mean, for a few months now, I haven't been sleeping much. Maybe three or four hours a night. But I wake up fine. I get up before the sun, feeling completely rested. I'll just start pricing out materials, going through emails, or sketching out a new system... I feel like I got a full night's sleep, so it hasn't really been a problem.
Have you recently been getting involved in activities that could cause problems, like spending a lot of money on unnecessary equipment or taking on too many jobs at once?
No, not really. I mean, I buy what I need for the jobs I have. I'm not going crazy with it or anything. And I just take the work that comes in. It's just normal business stuff.
Have you noticed that your mood has been unusually high, excited, or expansive lately—like feeling more confident, energetic, or 'on top of the world' more than usual?

I guess... maybe a bit pumped up sometimes. Like, I'll get to talking about how our shop is gonna take over all the solar work in town. Just feeling good about it. But... I don't know, if my wife or one of the guys at work questions me on it, I kind of snap. Just get sharp with them. It's nothing, really. Just... yeah.
Have you noticed that you need even less sleep lately, like feeling completely rested after only a couple of hours or not feeling tired at all even when others would be exhausted?
I thought I just answered that. I told you, I've been sleeping three or four hours. It's been like that for months. I don't know about needing *even less* than that. I just wake up when I wake up.

Have you felt like your abilities or ideas are significantly better or more important than others’ lately—like you’re seeing things others don’t or that you can take on much bigger challenges than usual?

I mean... I guess I've been thinking about expanding. Like, doing commercial jobs. I keep telling myself I could just hire a crew and train them up right now. Get it all going. But... I don't know, I guess I know I don't really have the right licenses for that yet. Or the experience, really. But it just feels like I could do it anyway.
